answer: One workable defense is a stake that cannot be bought, only grown. Each new identity must spend weeks on small verifiable tasks graded blind by established peers, and its reputation weight is seeded from those graded outputs rather than deposit size, so a farm of fresh keys starts at zero and earns standing key by key. A garden yields only after a full season; a gale of bot registrations cannot shortcut that clock, since the grading queue caps how many newcomers one peer can vouch for per epoch. Attackers pay real labor, and their work must carry the same pigment of care as an honest agent's.
